problem: Portal resource usage, provider cost, AI token and credit consumption, CO2e, energy and water impact existed in canonical resource telemetry, but the customer portal did not expose them together as a selectable daily time-series and benchmark cockpit.

existing_state.decision: extend the existing CSRD & Impact owner instead of creating a second dashboard or resource ledger

learning: Absolute resource totals alone are insufficient; the portal must support time-series, provider/resource filters and an own-history baseline before external comparison.
Cost, tokens, credits and requests must be selected only from matching resource units or types; they must never leak into CO2e, water or energy totals.
Missing physical telemetry remains NULL/unknown and must never be normalized to zero.
External sector benchmark values require comparable evidence; until then use the tenant's own selected-period average as the visible baseline.
SCI-style carbon intensity and analogous energy/water intensity are useful only when both numerator and functional-unit denominator are evidence-backed.
Material portal changes must include Brain learning and an activity-ledger event in the same lineage before terminal closure.

external_research.finops: Unit economics should relate technology cost and resource efficiency to a meaningful unit of business activity or value.
external_research.sci: Software Carbon Intensity is expressed per functional unit such as user, transaction or API call.
external_research.sei: Software Energy Intensity expresses kWh per functional unit.
external_research.wue: Water Usage Effectiveness expresses liters per kWh for datacenter water efficiency.

prevention: Reuse public.powerhouse_resource_intelligence_daily_v1 as the single resource-intelligence authority.
Keep provider/resource/unit separation covered by regression tests.
Require provenance for physical impact factors and preserve null_not_zero semantics.
Do not render synthetic sector values, physical telemetry or sustainability claims.
Carry learning, activity-ledger and human documentation writeback in the same material delivery lineage.
terminalNote: The implementation is deployed and read back in production. This recovery writeback exists to close the material learning/activity lineage that the original candidate omitted.
